turns.text: need to write a short email to my prof following up on ashby's letter. i stopped by his thursday office hours and he said to follow up later

Happy to help. A few quick things so it's accurate: what do you want the email to say about timing, and is there anything you'd like me to mention about why it matters? Here's a draft meanwhile:

Subject: Following up on recommendation letter

Dear Dr. Ashby,

Thank you for taking the time to talk with me during your Thursday office hours. As you suggested, I'm following up about the recommendation letter I requested. Could you let me know roughly when you expect to have it ready?

Thank you again for your support.

Best,
[your name]
can you mention i'm in his tues/thurs ops management class, he has a lot of students. and lowkey add that i have a phone screen coming up next week so timing matters, but dont make it sound pushy

Sure, here's a version that works those in gently:

Subject: Following up on recommendation letter, Operations Management

Dear Dr. Ashby,

I'm a student in your Tuesday/Thursday operations management section. Thank you for speaking with me during your Thursday office hours. As you suggested, I'm following up on the recommendation letter I requested.

I have an interview coming up next week, so I wanted to ask whether you have a rough sense of when the letter might be ready. Any timeline is helpful, and I completely understand if your schedule is full.

Thank you again for your time and support.

Best,
[your name]
perfect thx. th tone is good
Glad it works. If you'd like, I can make a shorter two-sentence version too. Good luck with the interview!
